purpose: Canonical idempotent write capability for append-only Confirmation attestation by the authenticated self toward one exact Outcome disposition MaterialState and purpose.

routine.return_type: TABLE(confirmation_ref uuid, outcome_ref uuid, outcome_disposition_material_state_ref uuid, confirmer_person_ref uuid, purpose_code text, material_state_ref uuid, stance_code text, confirmer_is_self boolean, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Appends one immutable Confirmation attestation state per accepted creation/correction.
state_history.current_binding: Advances scoped_current_material_state for confirmation.attestation and preserves current-history episodes.
state_history.chronology: Currentness is explicit and never latest-row semantics.
state_history.immutability_policy: Historical attestation MaterialStates and the Outcome MaterialState pin are never rewritten.

obligations: pin to exact Outcome disposition MaterialState
